messages:
Rina: heads-up — our dashboard shows a small but steady percentage (~7%) of demo-request leads unclaimed after 10m in the last 24h. mostly from APAC. pinging @Omar @Bea. https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/filter/unclaimed-demo :eyes:
Omar: curious if these are RR only or also direct-assign. any enrichment timeouts noted?
Bea: I sampled 50 leads. ~85% are RR. enrichment vendor latency spiked (p95 ~3.6s) + webhook 502s during the window. RR ack_window currently 12s — seems too small when enrichment + SF owner provisioning happen.
Logan: business impact: demo leads need same-day outreach. propose short-term: extend ack_window to 60s for campaign=webinar/demo (canary 10%), enable prewarm_enrichment for those campaigns, and add immediate fallback owner after 8m.
HubSpot Bot: webhook-monitor: 502/504 cluster 2024-09-10T09:12:02 - 09:20:44 (26 events). ref: hs/webhook/2024-09-10
SF Connector Bot: owner_provision_delay average 16s for sampled leads. ref: sf-sync/metrics/2024-09-10
Omar: agree. i'll open a small router PR with a canary flag + heartbeat metric (pct_unclaimed_10m_by_campaign). will set canary 10% for 30m.
Bea: i'll add HS workflow fallback mapping: after 8m unclaimed -> assign marketing-fallback and send an enriched lead summary to #sales. also coordinate with SF mapping to avoid duplicate churn.
Rina: owners: Omar (PR + canary + metric), Bea (HS fallback + sales notify), Logan (rollback criteria + monitoring). i'll schedule a 15m sync after canary is live. :calendar:
Omar: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/leadrouter/pull/560  canary start ts 1778880030. will post early metrics here. :rocket:
Rina: rollback criteria: pct_unclaimed_10m increases or SF owner errors spike above baseline. thanks team. :thumbsup:
